verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers fraud decisioning, chargeback/dispute automation, PCI scope, mobile/3DS SDK existence, and agentic order tagging, but contains no mention of SCA, 3D Secure exemption logic, PSD2 compliance, or intelligent routing of European traffic between 3DS challenge and exemption requests. The 3DS SDK docs (forter-docs-31, forter-docs-32) only describe SDK installation, not decision logic for when 3DS is triggered vs exempted.
